decisions.reason: Reassigning SCL0 from GPIO22 to GPIO38 does not change the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, cable length, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The interboard connector continues to carry signals named SCL0 and 5V_EN; changing their MCU GPIO assignments does not change the connector pinout or matching-board requirement.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing boost_enable_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing control_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5; no additional update or removal is required.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the selected 5V LED supply or the requirement for a data-level shifter.
The source changes MCU GPIO assignments but does not change the sensor modules, their connector role, or their 3.3V supply.
The changed GPIO assignments do not affect the standalone regulator, its activation condition, load, or source-selection topology.
The source does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or normal-operation power-path requirements.
The GPIO changes do not alter the separate board's eight-LED count, SK6812 family, or board role.
The GPIO compatibility correction does not change any component availability, cost, or connector-sourceability policy.
